files.notes: Durable document WhatsApp delivery snapshots retain filenames/passenger/contact/provider metadata with one distributed-document and unique provider-message identity. Agency/group deletion cascades; source document/passenger/recipient references SETNULL preserve delivery history. Current PII retention/authorization and external unknown-outcome semantics require runtime evidence, not schema-only claims.
Adds false-by-default Agent/Employee-code collection option without changing existing group behavior; current field validation independent.
Adds optional alternate edit-source key plus sharpness default1 and range1–3, preserving original crop/source fields; object cleanup and authority not proven by additive schema.

Adds explicit sharpness algorithm version constrained1/2, durable AI image provenance/content/prompt hashes and unique per-submission generated storage key; creator SETNULL/submission cascade. Sensitive prompt/storage provenance retention and current service authority remain independent.

Creates durable Visa image jobs with one queued/running job per submission, bounded attempts/status, durable task/result/source metadata and result/requester SETNULL. Current worker retry/provider/lease semantics and object lifecycle not qualified here.

Backfills shared valid/rejected WhatsApp roster order deterministically from creation time plus stable type/id tie-breakers, explicitly not pretending to recover original spreadsheet interleaving. Both backfills use unchanged source ordering fields and add nonunique group/order indexes; no recipient deletion or provider sends.

Export checkpoints constrain kind/mode/counts/completion and group-kind-request idempotency, with snapshots and nullable baseline/actor history. Roster resolutions constrain active/restored/replacement/rejected states, preserve originals, and add partial active recipient/submission uniqueness plus suppression backlink. Active replacement requires recipient presence although FK uses SETNULL; deletion compatibility depends on supported restore-before-delete policy and later schema/runtime, not a source-only active defect.
Adds empty-list group custom question schema and passport answer snapshots; runtime bound/type/schema/redaction checks are independent of JSONB storage declarations.

Normalizes activity names, ranks active then oldest stable id to canonicalize duplicate draft/active sessions without changing session status or attendance rows; completed history self-canonical. Adds self-reference and partial active canonical group/name uniqueness. Runtime alias authorization and replay limits remain independent.

Adds false-by-default designation/dealership flags and empty-list typed detail definitions/answer snapshots, preserving existing group forms. Runtime validation/security beyond schema not evaluated from these declarations.

Creates shared original/manual/AI image library preserving Visa AI row IDs for durable job result identity. Copies still-live legacy edit variants and original fields with deterministic UUIDs and ON CONFLICT storage dedup; excludes Excel placeholder front keys. No original blobs deleted. Current runtime lifecycle is root-owned; metadata source read does not prove storage existence/cleanup.

Menu foundation supports platform categories via nullable agency and separate partial uniqueness for global versus agency names; dishes unique within category, plans bound1–60days and entries unique plan/day/meal with snapshot names and nullable dish/category SETNULL. Current tenant/category authorization and nonrepetition algorithm require runtime evidence.

Upgrade replaces one-dish-per-meal uniqueness with per-category uniqueness. Downgrade explicitly and deterministically deletes all but first category-name/id entry per meal before restoring old constraint; documented lossy historical rollback boundary, not a new active service bug. Nullable category-ID uniqueness follows PostgreSQL null behavior; runtime consistency independent.

Adds persisted allocation revision/fingerprint/options and unique group/passenger hotel membership; backfill deterministically selects newest assignment while retaining old assignment rows and derives VIP from room/preference. Existing check-in hotels receive stale zero fingerprint/revision1 to force explicit allocation verification; actual service lock/workflow semantics require runtime evidence.
Adds nullable account-deleted timestamp without purging history, disabling accounts or revoking credentials by schema itself. Current managed-account runtime review owned by parent and separate.

Widens crop angle range to0–359. Downgrade explicitly normalizes each fine angle to nearest right angle before narrowing check, preserving constraint-valid old representation with intentional precision loss. No image processing or object mutation in migration.

notes: Complete0045–0060 physical reads in four bounded outputs; no runtime/migration/service/provider changes. Root image-runtime ownership respected.
